## Fig N1 — CONSTRUCT-MP 四步推导流水线

**插入锚点**：§3.3.2 "Construction of the MetaPattern set"，Step 1–4 的 `description` 列表之后
（`\end{description}` 与 Remark `rem:mp-per-class` 之间）。

```latex
\begin{figure}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=0.42\columnwidth]{figures/fig_N1_construct-mp.pdf}
  \caption{The CONSTRUCT-MP procedure. From the structural decomposition
  $\mathcal{D}(\mathcal{A}_P)$ (five MetaPatterns, two refinements, and the
  relational extension), four mechanical steps---invariant extraction,
  MR derivation via \texttt{Translate}, quotient under $\sim_s$, and
  aggregation---produce the MetaPattern set $\mathbb{M}(\mathcal{A}_P)$,
  closed under \texttt{Translate} (Theorem~\ref{thm:closure}) and
  polynomial-time constructible under a finite generating set
  (Theorem~\ref{thm:decidable}).}
  \label{fig:construct-mp}
\end{figure}
```

正文引用：`the four mechanical steps of CONSTRUCT-MP (Figure~\ref{fig:construct-mp})`。

```latex

  executable MR families (Layer~2) they instantiate. The map is one-to-many
  and program-family dependent (e.g.\ the Invariance MetaPattern
  $m_{\mathrm{inv}}$, generated by the group action $G$, yields both the

  extension ($\mathcal{B}^{*}_{\mathrm{rel}}$, the exact idempotent-semiring
  specialisation of family~j) enter at Layer~2 (dashed). I/M are the MR modes
  of Definition~\ref{def:mr-mode}. Letters a--j cross-reference
  Table~\ref{tab:mr-families}.}
```

正文引用：`the one-to-many MetaPattern-to-family map (Figure~\ref{fig:two-layer-map})`。

## Fig N3 — L\*-MetaPattern 盲性核心实证结果

**插入锚点**：§4 "Central result: $\mathcal{L}^{*}$-MetaPattern blindness, confirmed"
（`subsec:l-blindness-confirmed`），Table~\ref{tab:l-blindness} 之后。

```latex
\begin{figure}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{figures/fig_N3_l-blindness.pdf}
  \caption{Per-SUT $L_{\mathrm{scale}}$ MR kill rate on PIT mutants of the six
  $\mathcal{L}^{*}$-admitting SUTs. Five of six register zero kills;
  \texttt{hypotSig} ($2/4$) is the sole outlier, and its two killed mutants are
  the homogeneity-breaking constant-replacements predicted as the residual tail
  in \S\ref{subsec:l-blindness-derivation}. All but \texttt{hypotSig} lie at or
  below the $1/3$ per-SUT falsification threshold (dashed); pooled
  $2/44\approx4.5\%$, an order of magnitude below Set~N's $0.486$ average.
  Counts from Table~\ref{tab:l-blindness}.}
  \label{fig:l-blindness}
\end{figure}
```

正文引用：`the prediction is confirmed on five of six SUTs (Figure~\ref{fig:l-blindness})`。

## Fig N4 — 逐 MetaPattern head-to-head：Set N vs Set G

**插入锚点**：§4 head-to-head（`subsec:pooled-headtohead`），Table~\ref{tab:per-block-headtohead}
之后。

```latex
\begin{figure}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{figures/fig_N4_per-metapattern-h2h.pdf}
  \caption{Per-MetaPattern PIT kill rate, Set~N (algebra-derived) versus Set~G
  (GP-evolved), with Wilson 95\% confidence intervals, on the PIT-covered
  substrate. Set~N edges Set~G on the $G_{\mathrm{tr}}$ translation sub-class
  ($10/17$ vs $8/17$); Set~G dominates on the $G$ and $\mathcal{L}^{*}$
  MetaPatterns. The per-MetaPattern samples ($n_b\le24$) are underpowered and the
  intervals overlap, so the panel is read as complementarity, not superiority.
  Data from Table~\ref{tab:per-block-headtohead}.}
  \label{fig:per-mp-h2h}
\end{figure}
```

正文引用：`the gap concentrates on the $G$ and $\mathcal{L}^{*}$ MetaPatterns, partially offset by Set~N's $G_{\mathrm{tr}}$ edge (Figure~\ref{fig:per-mp-h2h})`。
